title: Core Chain Component
summary: This module defines the abstract `Chain` base class, providing a foundational structure for building sequences of operations. It integrates state management via memory and observability through callbacks, enabling complex, stateful, and traceable workflows.

nodes.label: Chain Base Class
nodes.title: Abstract Chain Definition
nodes.description: The abstract base class (`Chain`) defining the fundamental interface and lifecycle for all chains, including input/output handling, memory integration, and callback management.

nodes.label: Prepare Inputs
nodes.title: Input Pre-processing
nodes.description: Handles initial input validation, formatting, and loading of state from memory before the chain's core logic executes, ensuring all necessary data is available.

nodes.label: Execute Chain Logic
nodes.title: Chain Specific Implementation
nodes.description: The abstract method (`_call` / `_acall`) where concrete chain implementations define their specific sequence of operations, such as calling LLMs, tools, or other sub-components.

nodes.label: Finalize Outputs
nodes.title: Output Post-processing
nodes.description: Validates the results from the core logic, saves updated state to memory, and structures the final output for the caller, ensuring consistency and completeness.

nodes.label: Memory System
nodes.title: State Management (BaseMemory)
nodes.description: Provides stateful context to chains by loading and saving variables, enabling conversational history or other persistent data across multiple chain invocations.

nodes.label: Callback System
nodes.title: Observability (CallbackManager)
nodes.description: Allows for custom actions and logging at various points during a chain's execution, such as start, end, or error events, facilitating observability and debugging.

groups.label: Chain Component
groups.title: Main Chain Component
groups.description: The central abstract class that orchestrates the execution flow of a sequence of operations.

groups.label: Internal Execution Steps
groups.title: Internal Chain Execution Steps
groups.description: The sequential steps involved in processing inputs, executing the core logic, and finalizing outputs within a chain.

groups.label: Data Management
groups.title: Chain Data Management
groups.description: External systems responsible for maintaining state and providing observability for the chain's operations.

groups.label: Observability
groups.title: Chain Observability
groups.description: External systems responsible for providing observability for the chain's operations.
